coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all four PMT summaries and four SR pages. Retained water, alloy, polymer and Haber diagrams, detailed NPK salts and preparation. Added treatment selection, reuse break-even example, corrosion mechanism and composite roles. Rejected source claims that phosphate rock supplies potassium, heating thermoplastics breaks backbone chains, composite properties depend only on binder, sewage treatment is not used in UK, and positive ion tests alone establish potability.
